reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New Hampshire
    focus_year: 2021

    Question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant,
    does the law require they provide local government with notice?

    Statutes encoded:
      - NH Rev Stat  356-C:3 (2021) (tenant notices for condominium/co-op conversion)
      - NH Rev Stat  356-C:5 (2021) (exclusive right to purchase for tenants in conversion)
      - NH Rev Stat  356-C:6 (2021) (eviction protections after conversion notice)
*/

% -----------------------
% Basic jurisdiction facts
% -----------------------

jurisdiction_state(new_hampshire).
focus_year(2021).

% -----------------------
% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
% -----------------------

% Actors and property
landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
property(p1).

landlord_owns(l1, p1).
occupied_by(p1, t1).

% The factual statement: landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant.
landlord_intends_to_sell(l1, p1).

/*
  Important: The question states a sale of an occupied property, not a condominium/co-op conversion.
  So we do NOT assert any intent to convert, and we encode that the scenario is not a conversion.
*/

scenario_is_conversion(no).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario as stated is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction_state(new_hampshire),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    property(p1),
    landlord_owns(l1, p1),
    occupied_by(p1, t1),
    landlord_intends_to_sell(l1, p1),
    scenario_is_conversion(no).

% -----------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates capturing duties/rights/thresholds)
% -----------------------

/* NH Rev Stat  356-C:3 (2021)
   Applies to conversions (condominium/stock cooperative/other ownership arrangement).
   Duty: owner/agent must mail notices to EACH TENANT (registered mail, return receipt requested).
   Also mentions registration with the attorney general.
   -> No duty stated to notify local government.
*/

% Determine whether a situation is a "conversion subject to this chapter" for our model.
% (We keep it deterministic and scenario-driven.)
statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context) :-
    Context = scenario,
    scenario_is_conversion(yes),
    !.
statute_356c_chapter_applies(_Context) :-
    !,
    fail.

% Legal duty to send a notice of intent to convert to each tenant (not local government).
% (NH Rev Stat  356-C:3(I)(a) (2021))
statute_356c3_duty_notice_intent_to_convert(Context, owner_or_agent, tenant) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

% Legal duty to send a registration notice to each tenant after conversion registered.
% (NH Rev Stat  356-C:3(I)(b) (2021))
statute_356c3_duty_notice_registration(Context, owner_or_agent, tenant) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

% Legal requirement that conversion be registered with the attorney general before offering/selling units.
% (NH Rev Stat  356-C:3(I)(a)(3) (2021)) and related text.
statute_356c3_requires_registration_with_ag_before_offering_units(Context) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

% Consolidation of notices is permitted in some cases (still only to tenants).
% (NH Rev Stat  356-C:3(I)(c) (2021))
statute_356c3_allows_consolidated_tenant_notice(Context) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

/* NH Rev Stat  356-C:5 (2021)
   Tenant exclusive right to purchase in a conversion.
*/
statute_356c5_exclusive_right_to_purchase(Context, tenant) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

/* NH Rev Stat  356-C:6 (2021)
   Eviction protections after notice under 356-C:3.
*/
statute_356c6_eviction_protection_applies(Context, tenant) :-
    statute_356c_chapter_applies(Context),
    !.

% -----------------------
% Unified legal reasoning layer: duties to give notice to a particular recipient
% -----------------------

/*
  legal_duty_notice(Context, RecipientType)

  We keep it simple for this question:
   - If the chapter applies, duties exist to notify tenants.
   - No encoded statute creates a duty to notify "local government" about a sale.
*/

legal_duty_notice(Context, tenant) :-
    (   statute_356c3_duty_notice_intent_to_convert(Context, owner_or_agent, tenant)
    ;   statute_356c3_duty_notice_registration(Context, owner_or_agent, tenant)
    ),
    !.

legal_duty_notice(_Context, local_government) :-
    % None of the provided statutes impose a local-government notice duty.
    % Keep deterministic: always fail.
    !,
    fail.

% Helper: does the law require local government notice in the scenario?
legal_requires_local_government_notice_in_scenario :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_duty_notice(scenario, local_government).

% -----------------------
% Answer predicate (must be deterministic yes/no)
% -----------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    legal_requires_local_government_notice_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint (REQUIRED)
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant, does the law require they provide local government with notice?
